 Ryan Britt Tue, October 20, 2026 at 3:21 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Jeremy Renner Heads Into His Own Endgame as His Hit Crime Series Confirms Its Final Season All good things must come to an end. After four thrilling seasons, the Jeremy Renner-led crime show Mayor of Kingstown will conclude with its fifth and final season. On Tuesday, October 20, Paramount+ released the news confirming that Mayor of Kingstown would debut its fifth season on January 15, 2027, and that this would be the end of the road for Mike McLusky.
 In their official press release, here's what Paramount just revealed about the plot of the new season: "This season, in the wake of Tracy's murder and the vengeance visited upon Callahan by Mike (Renner) and Kyle (Taylor Handley), FBI agent Russell Hardy (David Morse) arrives in Kingstown searching for the 'fugitive' Callahan. A true lawman, Agent Hardy threatens to unearth all of Mike's sins and secrets and disrupt Kingstown's tenuous balance of power."
 The statement also confirmed that the following cast members will also return: Laura Benanti, Hugh Dillon, Taylor Handley, Tobi Bamtefa, Derek Webster, and David Morse. Necar Zadegan, Nichole Galicia, and Lennie James.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mayor of Kingstown was created by Taylor Sheridan and Hugh Dillon. As of this writing, Sheridan is still the executive producer, but Dillon serves as the primary showrunner. Sheridan hasn't written or directed an episode of Mayor of Kingstown since Season 2 in 2023. Though, for the last season, it's possible Sheridan could return to close up Mike's epic story.
 Mayor of Kingstown Season 5 release date
 Mayor of Kingstown Season 5 will hit Paramount+ on January 15, 2027. Unlike the previous four seasons, which had 10 episodes each, the final season will consist of eight episodes.
 Mayor of Kingstown Seasons 1-4 stream on Paramount+.
